candidate_workaround: Verify commit-local Git blob identity separately from the declared working-tree checkout-byte domain.
failure_signature: The first manifest verifier compared working-tree checkout-byte counts with raw Git blob sizes and falsely classified four entries as mismatches.
recurrence_guard: Read manifest domain metadata before comparing hashes or byte counts.
rollback: Withdraw the false mismatch classification and retain the domain error.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-scoped verification only; no independent reproduction credit.
title: Separate Git blob identity from checkout-byte counts
trigger_preconditions: A manifest declares different hash and checkout-byte domains.
